description: This file defines a React functional component 'PreviewEditor' that renders Markdown content with custom note linking behavior. It manages note interactions such as updating active and selected notes, and swapping folders based on user clicks.

classes.name: PreviewEditor
classes.description: React functional component for rendering Markdown content with custom note linking and folder management.

methods.name: _updateSelectedNotes
methods.description: Dispatches action to update selected notes based on note ID and multi-select flag.

methods.name: _updateActiveNote
methods.description: Dispatches action to set a note as the active note.

methods.name: _swapFolder
methods.description: Dispatches action to swap the current folder, e.g., to favorites or trash.

methods.name: handleNoteLinkClick
methods.description: Handles clicks on note links, updating note state and folder based on note properties.

methods.name: returnNoteLink
methods.description: Returns a NoteLink React element for a given note UUID.
